unit.why: An autobiographical memorate (from R. Yitzhak Isaac of Komarno's Megillat Setarim): in his youth he was overcome by temptation of the eyes, wept alone in the synagogue until he fainted, and was then granted heavenly protection from seeing a married woman.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a numbered sequence of excerpts from the same memoir; self-contained episode

stories.start_quote: מספר עוד שם מזמן היותו י"ב שנה
stories.end_quote: בהיותו כבן ט״ז שנים והמובן לפי החשבון
stories.summary_en: As a boy of 12–15 the author was overcome by Samael and failed to guard his eyes; he then wept alone in the synagogue before God until he fainted, and from then on he never looked at a married woman, receiving heavenly protection against it and returning to Torah and prayer.
